task_metadata.research_topic: Discrete causal discovery and Bayesian network structure learning on bnlearn benchmarks
task_metadata.research_question: Design a causal discovery algorithm that recovers the CPDAG from purely observational discrete data sampled from real-world Bayesian networks in the bnlearn repository.
notes: Baselines were mapped to canonical structure-learning papers plus the BDeu scoring paper used by the bnlearn-style score-and-search implementations.
The linked test papers cover the benchmark networks with explicit references; tests without a clear single publication in the bnlearn notes are left unlinked rather than guessed.

tests.label: Cancer
tests.notes: bnlearn lists this benchmark with a textbook reference rather than a single canonical paper; left unlinked.

tests.label: Child
tests.notes: Linked to the probabilistic expert-systems chapter that bnlearn cites for Child.

tests.label: Alarm
tests.notes: The ALARM benchmark has a canonical conference paper in the bnlearn repository notes.

tests.label: Hailfinder
tests.notes: Linked to the original Hailfinder forecasting paper.

tests.label: Win95pts
tests.notes: bnlearn does not list a clear single source paper for this benchmark; left unlinked.

baselines.name: pc
baselines.notes: Mapped to the original PC algorithm paper.

baselines.name: ges
baselines.notes: GES is linked to Chickering's GES paper and the BDeu score paper used by the bnlearn-style scorer.

baselines.name: grasp
baselines.notes: Linked to the GRaSP paper plus the BDeu score paper.

baselines.name: boss
baselines.notes: BOSS is linked to its NeurIPS paper; the Chickering equivalence-class paper is attached as methodological background.

baselines.name: hc
baselines.notes: Linked to a dedicated hill-climbing structure-learning paper plus the BDeu score paper.
